description: Redemption Spaulders Level 60 Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a pair of Redemption Spaulders if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Spaulders, 12 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 2 Arcanite Bars and 2 Nexus Crystals. Requirements: - Desecrated Spaulders - Wartorn Plate Scrap x 12 - Arcanite Bar x 2 - Nexus Crystal x 2
